verdict.rationale: Apple documents external connectivity concretely: Thunderbolt 5 at up to 120Gb/s, and external display limits of two 6K60 displays over Thunderbolt, or one 6K60 plus one 4K144 over HDMI. That is enough to plan a dock setup, but the pack has no PCIe generation or lane information and no storage speed specs, so only about one of the story's three I/O elements is covered. Missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane documentation, internal storage throughput specs, port count and topology details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the I/O claims.
